## NoMac (Remote)

NoMac's hosted MCP server gives an agent cloud iPhone Simulators and macOS VMs with Xcode. On a phone, the agent builds and runs an iOS app from a git repository or an uploaded folder, reads the screen as text, taps and types by label, reads app logs and runs tests. On a Mac, it runs shell commands, builds with `xcodebuild`, reads and writes files, takes screenshots and sends keyboard and mouse input. Use it to build and test iOS and macOS apps from Linux, Windows or a cloud agent without a Mac.

### Setup

You need a NoMac account with prepaid credit. Run `thv run nomac-remote --remote-auth` and sign in to NoMac in the browser. The server supports dynamic client registration, so no API key, pre-created OAuth application, or custom headers are required.

Phones and Macs are billed per minute from the account's credit while they run; prices are at https://nomac.app. Each Mac is a single-tenant VM that is deleted when its session stops; files in `~/drive` are kept between sessions.
